text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Certificate/Diploma of highest educationThe certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized4. Letter of recommendation One letter of recommendation in English or Chinese5. Sponsor letter from sponsor in Beijing Qualification of sponsor:A permanent resident in Beijing with steady job Content of Sponsor letter: Include name, occupation, phone number, and mailing address Sample Sponsor letter is available on request
